Chapter 1314 - 2: Where Did My Gourd Go?

Chapter 1314: Chapter 2: Where Did My Gourd Go?

Deep in his mind, the majestic and grand Myriad Realms Gate trembled slightly.

At the very bottom, a new world coordinate pattern slowly formed.

"Is this an unknown dimensional space?"

Lin Yuan immediately understood in his heart.

When the Myriad Realms Gate approaches an independent world, it automatically captures the specific coordinates for Lin Yuan to traverse and descend.

Lin Yuan had already witnessed this ability in previous traversals.

For example, the Central Divine Continent, Spirit Realm, and even the Immortal Realm, all came about this way.

Soon.

Lin Yuan found himself before that dimensional space.

Compared to the immense and unrestrained Chaos Void, this dimensional space seemed much smaller.

Perhaps only one percent of the size of the Chaos Void, it was assumed that not even time-based life had been nurtured here.

However.

When Lin Yuan attempted to blend his mind into this dimensional space, he encountered fierce resistance.

This dimensional space instinctively rejected Lin Yuan, and if he tried to forcibly enter, it would cause the entire space to collapse directly.

"No wonder even beings as powerful as time-based life forms have very limited explorations of other dimensional spaces because the opportunity simply doesn’t exist."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Each dimensional space operates with uniquely different Dao rules, and for time-based life forms, experiencing these different operations is a unique cultivation experience.

Yet, do time-based life forms wish to explore other dimensional spaces?

If it’s as vast as the Chaos Void, it’s impossible to explore, as the awareness of the space itself can suppress the majority of them.

Not to mention that such dimensional spaces in the Chaos Void have even nurtured some time-based life.

The second source world, the Lord of Heaven Light was able to integrate, firstly, because the innate consciousness was not fully restored at its inception, and secondly, there were no other time-based life forms born yet.

It was only by paying a devastating price that success was achieved.

If not for the fact that the source world contained a trace of perfect aura, the actions of the Lord of Heaven Light would have been totally unworthy.

...

And if it’s a relatively weaker dimensional space? The Dao rules would correspondingly be weaker, and even so, the dimensional space itself would resist any invading life, including time-based life forms.

If one forcibly invades and explores, the greatest possibility is the collapse of the dimensional space, causing backlash and severe injury to the time-based life form itself.

Therefore, Thirteenth Rank time-based life forms feel both desire and helplessness towards other dimensional spaces.

...

Lin Yuan looked at the dimensional space in front of him.

Other time-based life, when facing this dimensional space, would also only watch from afar, unless they wished to destroy everything, otherwise, there wouldn’t really be many methods.

They could only slightly explore the periphery and couldn’t delve deeply.

But Lin Yuan was different.

Since it was recorded by the Myriad Realms Gate.

It meant Lin Yuan could perfectly descend through it.

When descending to any world using the Myriad Realms Gate, one would perfectly integrate; neither the innate awareness of the dimensional space nor the internal world consciousness would sense it at all.

"I could explore it when I have time."

Lin Yuan pondered for a while and continued heading towards the Yin Yang flower’s location.

Compared to other time-based lives, Lin Yuan had far too many choices of dimensional spaces, not to mention the Myriad Realms Gate’s ’customized’ traversals, just the remaining thirty-one source worlds could keep him exploring for a long time.

This current dimensional space, which doesn’t even reach one percent of the Chaos Void’s mass, left Lin Yuan slightly disinterested.

...

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan’s true self sat cross-legged, constantly monitoring the movements of the Taiji Primordial Spirit.

After all, the Yin Yang flower determined whether he could elevate his Chaotic Taiji Dao to the Third Layer before entering the Thirteenth Rank.

Decades passed.

Lin Yuan also observed more of his future timelines.

He understood that relying solely on himself, to have the Chaotic Taiji Dao reach the Third Layer before crossing into Thirteenth Rank, would take eighty thousand years.

However, with the help of the Yin Yang flower, he could reach the Third Layer in twenty thousand years.

"That dimensional space..."

Lin Yuan contemplated the newly discovered dimensional space of the Taiji Primordial Spirit.

"It seems that the future timelines I’ve observed are still not comprehensive enough."

Lin Yuan thought in his heart, discovering this dimensional space was entirely unexpected, it hadn’t appeared in the future timelines he had seen.

This was also quite normal.

Every moment generates countless future timelines, and every time node on these timelines further creates more timelines.

Unless one is a Fourteenth Rank Perfect Time Being who can comprehend all timelines and discern past and future, even the strongest time-based being has moments of ’miscalculation’.

Not to mention Lin Yuan himself wasn’t a time-based life form, so the future timelines he observed were indeed limited.

The emergence of variables outside of the timelines was entirely typical.

"Continue cultivating."

Lin Yuan refocused his thoughts, over the decades, besides devoting part of his mind to observing his future timelines, most of his energy was still on cultivation, like comprehending and cultivating the Chaotic Taiji Dao.

As well as cultivating the Sixth Layer of "Infinite Void."

This Thirteenth Rank legacy, since Lin Yuan integrated the foundational structures of the other two source worlds, has completely transcended the scope of the original legacy, even exceeding the expectations of its creator.

The original goal of the "Infinite Void" was merely the Chaos Void, and even if one reached the theoretical seventh level, it would only be close to the level of a Time Lord.

However, the ultimate goal of Lin Yuan’s internal universe now is a perfect world.

...

"Now I have completed eighty percent of the development of the particle world, with only twenty percent left to fully develop the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World."

Every moment, a large number of microscopic particles are being developed within Lin Yuan, and vast worlds are being born, then reconstructed with the new "Infinite Void" legacy.

For the second source world, Lin Yuan spent thousands of years to open up the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World.

However, for the Chaos Void and the first source world, it only took decades to a century.

Resources are abundant.

Along with the proficiency of reopening it once more.

And the comprehension of runes.

Making Lin Yuan face no bottleneck or confusion in developing his own Infinite Constant Sand Particle World.

"Once the Infinite Constant Sand Particle World is opened, combined with completing the sixth layer of ’Infinite Void’, and the Chaotic Taiji Dao reaching the third level..."

"With all three completed, it will be the time for me to strike for the thirteenth rank."

Lin Yuan sets goals for himself.

In the many future timelines he observed, only when all three are achieved, and entering the thirteenth rank in the most perfect state, the improvement gained would be the greatest.

...

At the pinnacle of the Chaos Void.

This is a completely isolated space-time, where a majestic figure sits cross-legged, in a dormant state.

To call it dormant is actually misleading, as it is also a form of cultivation; the cultivation of a thirteenth-rank time life is not limited to simple seclusion.

Just at this moment.

The eyelids of this majestic figure stirred and slowly opened its eyes.

"How many events from ancient times till now, turn to emptiness like the ever-changing seas."

The majestic figure is in a good mood, evidently having gained a lot from this slumber.

For time life forms, every bit of progress is exceedingly rare, and many time lives spend countless ages standing still.

"Let me take a look at how those legacies established during my slumber are progressing."

The majestic figure’s thoughts stirred slightly.

In an instant, several special objects disappeared out of thin air from various places in the Chaos Void.

These special objects include a drop of crystal-clear tear, a slowly beating heart, and a star point emitting dazzling light, among others.

All are carriers of a certain thirteenth-rank legacy.

Soon.

Six special objects appeared before the majestic figure.

The thirteenth-rank legacies within the special objects were all created by the majestic figure and then spread around easily.

Every special object corresponds to a thirteenth-rank legacy, representing the ultimate in a certain aspect.

For example, that drop of crystal-clear tear contains a thirteenth-rank legacy named "Soul Illusion Realm," which pursues the extreme of the soul.

As for the slowly beating heart, the legacy within it is called "Infinite Body," which pursues the extreme of physical strength and form.

The star point emitting dazzling light pursues the ultimate of mental will for the thirteenth-rank legacy.

The other kinds of thirteenth-rank legacies are similar, all striving for the ultimate in a particular aspect.

The majestic figure created these legacies and spread them to cultivate a thirteenth-rank time life.

In the gaps between mysterious dimensions, thirteenth-rank time lives are like behemoths, occupying vast expanses of space-time. Many time lives ally with each other to gain more benefits.

As for how to form alliances? Naturally, it requires close relationships.

And the closest relationships? Surely, time lives coming from the same dimensional space are the closest.

The more time lives born in the Chaos Void before the great cataclysm, the stronger they will be when entering the dimensional gap in the future.

Thus.

Not only is the majestic figure trying to cultivate the thirteenth rank, but other time lives are also nurturing and leaving behind many thirteenth-rank legacies.

"Let me see, during my slumber, which legacy cultivators..."

The majestic figure’s gaze fell on each special object bearing the legacies.

These special objects all record information about the previous legacy holders. If the majestic figure deems it worthwhile to nurture, and this legacy holder has perished,

then it will resurrect them.

Twelfth-rank beings break free from the river of time, imprinting their life marks in the Chaos Void; only a thirteenth-rank time life can resurrect them.

"This one won’t do."

The majestic figure browsed through the information recorded in the tear drop in an instant and shook its head slightly.

The thirteenth-rank legacy representing the ultimate soul, the legacy holder, developed the most bizarre methods. The soul attack is formless and intangible, with even the defense being indefinable.

The majestic figure continued to look at the second and third special objects.

It quickly finished viewing the sixth special object.

"Hm?"

It was at this moment that the majestic figure realized something was amiss.

The special objects it had spread amounted to seven, representing the ultimate in seven aspects: mental will, soul, physical strength, inner world, etc.

Now only six special objects have arrived?

The majestic figure blinked and immediately responded:

"Where has my gourd gone?"
